title: Equip More Spells
description: A dark fantasy illustration shows a young sorceress with an elaborate headdress of mechanical tentacles and glowing rings, holding a pile of golden rings that spill from her hands. In the foreground, a mound of black sand is surrounded by lit candles and scattered rings, while ghostly figures and ink splatters fill the background.
prompt: A young sorceress with pale skin and intense eyes wears an intricate black headdress of mechanical tentacles and circular components, her hands cupped and overflowing with glowing golden rings that spill downward. In the foreground, a mound of black granular material is surrounded by several lit white candles and scattered golden rings on a dark surface. Ethereal ghostly figures and black ink splatters float in the smoky background, with soft golden bokeh orbs scattered throughout the composition, in a detailed dark fantasy ink illustration style.
